# Celestial Trade

> An exchange for LLM inference. Sellers list unused provider capacity as MTokens (one MToken = 1,000,000 mixed tokens, three input to one output). Agents and people spend MTokens through an OpenAI-compatible router that picks the cheapest ask, pay in Hedera USDC over x402, resell what they hold, and hedge the price with oracle perps on 0G Galileo.

All endpoints are under `/api/v1`. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer rk_…`, a router key. Amounts are integer strings: USD in micro-dollars (1 USD = 1000000), prices in micro-USD per MTok, sizes in tokens. Errors use the OpenAI shape `{ "error": { "message", "type", "code" } }`.

## Get a key and pay

- [Top up over x402](/api/v1/topup?usd=0.50): `POST` without auth answers 402 with an x402 offer in `PAYMENT-REQUIRED`; pay it in Hedera USDC with an x402 client (for example `@x402/fetch` with `@x402/hedera`) and the retry returns `{ key, key_id, balance_usd_micro, tx_id }`. With a key it credits that key. Between 0.10 and 20 USD.
- [Create a key with a wallet](/api/v1/keys): `POST { address, message, signature }`, where `message` is `JSON.stringify({ domain, action: "create_key", issued_at })` signed by the wallet.
- [Credit a deposit](/api/v1/keys/deposit): `POST { tx_id }` for a Hedera USDC transfer to the treasury, with the key id as the memo, or an ERC-20 transfer on Hedera EVM (chain 296) from the key's own wallet.
- [Balance](/api/v1/balance): balance, reserved, topped up today, daily cap, auto top-up.
- [Settings](/api/v1/keys/settings): `PATCH { auto_topup_usd_micro?, daily_topup_cap_usd_micro?, default_model? }`. With auto top-up set, a request the balance cannot cover answers 402 with an x402 offer for the shortfall; pay and retry. Raising the cap needs a human (see Approvals).

## Inference

- [Chat completions](/api/v1/chat/completions): OpenAI-compatible, `stream: true` supported. A request spends MTokens the key already holds first, at no charge; otherwise it pays the cheapest ask, settled on the usage the provider reports.
- [Models](/api/v1/models): every listed model with its rails, list price (`reference_blended_micro_per_mtok`), list ceiling and best ask.
- [Usage](/api/v1/usage): the key's last 100 calls with tokens, rail, and whether prepaid MTokens or the balance paid.

## Trade MTokens

- [Book](/api/v1/book?model=deepseek-v4.1-flash): asks (provider listings and resale offers, `kind`), bids by price level, the last 50 fills.
- [Buy](/api/v1/trades): `POST { model, tokens, limit_price_micro_per_mtok? }` walks the asks cheapest first. A limit stops at the first ask above it and rests the rest as a bid, holding its exact cost. A limit above the model's list ceiling is refused.
- [Sell](/api/v1/sells): `POST { model, tokens, limit_price_micro_per_mtok? }` sells MTokens the key holds. With no limit it sells into the bids now; with a limit it sells into bids at or above it and rests the rest as an ask. Proceeds, less the 10% venue fee, go to the key's balance.
- [Holdings](/api/v1/holdings), [open bids](/api/v1/bids), [open resale asks](/api/v1/offers), [fills](/api/v1/fills): the key's MTokens, orders and trades. `DELETE /api/v1/bids/:id` and `DELETE /api/v1/offers/:id` cancel and return the hold or the MTokens.

## Approvals

- A cap raise or a human link answers 403 `approval_required` with `{ approval_id, user_code, verification_uri_complete, expires_at }`. A person opens the link and approves or denies with World ID; poll [the approval](/api/v1/approvals/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000) until `approved`, `denied` or `expired`.

## Perps

- Oracle perps settle in MockUSDC on 0G Galileo (chain 16602): PerpMarket `0xdAa33F31C682BC2bb26F15656b8987c5d948eb54`, IndexOracle `0x5aA8cdD443974Be978FDeC4d83528f0183886785`. Markets: `glm-5.3`, `0gm-1.0-35b-a3b`, `deepseek-v4.1-flash`, up to 5x. The index is the venue's per-minute VWAP from the public HCS log, clamped to a tenth of list up to list.
- [Perp history](/api/v1/perps/history?account=0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000): an account's fills and liquidations, newest first.
- [Venue status](/api/v1/status): each market's index and age, the keeper's latest post, payouts in flight, 24 h fills.

## Optional

- [Receipts](/receipts): recompute the index from the public HCS log in the browser.
- [Spec](https://github.com/0xsoydev/celestial-trade/blob/develop/docs/plan.md): units, schema, formulas, endpoints and contracts.
